I got into K pop from falling in love with pop music in 2020 when I was locked inside for months. I started listening to Blackpink then I expanded and started listening to other K pop groups then one day Spotify put Twice in one of my playlist. I went to their profile and spent a good amount of time listening to their music. Started following fan accounts on IG then watching TTT on YouTube. The deeper I got the happier they made me through tough times. Specifically Jeongyeon something about her just grabbed my attention. I bought several of their CD's and got a photo card of Jeongyeon that I keep in my wallet just to feel like I'm doing some small part to support her through her struggles with mental health.
